contexts.text: Noon (in Hell) is the itch of Falsities.
Jehovah shall smite thee with... the itch... ().
The kinds of ulcers are haemorrhoids, scab, itch, which = so many kinds of falsities from evils...
They induced an itching... to bite off my tongue. SE 4589.
From the itching and lust of commanding... SE 5105.
They were in the itching to speak...
They inflicted the itching of a scab upon my body. Their character described.
They then feel the delight of hatred as the delight of love, but this from the itching of the flesh.
